description: This file is a shell script used for testing various submodule-related operations in a git repository. It includes functions for creating repositories, checking submodule states, resetting work trees, and testing interactions with submodules under different scenarios.

methods.name: create_lib_submodule_repo
methods.description: Initializes repositories with specific commit histories and submodules for testing various scenarios.

methods.name: replace_gitfile_with_git_dir
methods.description: Replaces a gitfile with a .git directory to simulate certain submodule states.

methods.name: test_git_directory_is_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that the git directory structure of a submodule remains unchanged.

methods.name: test_git_directory_exists
methods.description: Checks that a submodule's git directory exists properly.

methods.name: prolog
methods.description: Sets up global git configuration and creates initial repositories if needed before tests.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to
methods.description: Resets the work tree to a specified commit state, updating submodules accordingly.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to_interested
methods.description: Resets work tree and prepares submodules for specific test states.

methods.name: test_superproject_content
methods.description: Verifies that the superproject contains expected content for a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_content
methods.description: Verifies that a submodule contains expected content for a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_common
methods.description: Performs common submodule switch tests across different scenarios.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs tests for switching submodules with a given command, ensuring correct behavior.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Runs submodule switch tests using `git` command line.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch
methods.description: Runs forced switch tests where local changes are discarded.

methods.name: test_submodule_recursing_with_args_common
methods.description: Performs comprehensive testing of submodule operations with recursive and recursing options.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Runs forced switch tests with recursive submodule operations.
